advancement_gates: 95% player-cluster interval for Brier improvement versus chronology prevalence is above zero
wins at least 3 of four origins versus chronology prevalence
pooled Brier improvement versus market profile is positive
pooled ROC AUC is at least 0.70
absolute pooled calibration gap is at most 0.05
artifact_policy: No fitted model or calibrator is serialized; deployment remains unchanged.

calibration.selection: retain methods within raw +0.002 Brier and +0.01 log loss; choose lowest pooled ECE, with differences <=0.005 favoring simplicity

explanation_policy: The two recent-involvement inputs are reported as one grouped contribution when absolute Spearman correlation exceeds 0.90; no independent causal importance claim is allowed.

exposure_policy.known_exposure: V1 out-of-sample labels, predictions, and aggregate performance were inspected on 2026-08-22
exposure_policy.permitted_use: restricted confirmation of the exact frozen V1 artifacts only
exposure_policy.prohibited_use: feature selection, model selection, calibration, thresholding, refusal design, or V2 promotion

horizon_policy.12m: primary because it matures sooner and supports larger later cohorts
horizon_policy.24m: secondary and provisional because follow-up matures slowly and later subgroup support is small

hyperparameter_selection: C selected by preceding-year validation Brier loss
identity_policy: evaluation-player IDs are excluded from hyperparameter training, calibration/validation, and final fitting rows in each origin
scope: incumbent-club extension public-value downside development evidence
